title: The Delimitation of the Infinite, Angel, and Meditations on Poetry
source: Yevgeny Zamyatin, We, Record Twelve; original interpretive paraphrase

scenes.title: 01 · The Comfort of a Boundary
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: If only every thought could close as neatly as a circle.
scenes.story: After a dreamless night, D-503 expects O-90 to visit tomorrow and imagines becoming well again. He praises reasoning as the process of dividing an infinite unknown into manageable portions, finding security in the finite circle.
scenes.observation: He reports sleeping well, anticipates O-90, and praises mathematical delimitation.
scenes.inference: A useful finite model proves everything beyond its bounds is meaningless.
scenes.question: What does a finite model accomplish?
choices: It organizes a domain, without exhausting reality.
It guarantees total knowledge of all things.
reply: Correct: the narrative supports this narrower claim.
That larger claim has not been established.

scenes.title: 02 · A Book Beneath the Railway
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: Even the wheels seem to scan the verses into perfect meter.
scenes.story: D-503 rides underground, reading the book of verse R-13 gave him. The rolling carriage beats a regular rhythm, and he tries to align the measured poetry with the mechanical cadence of transport.
scenes.observation: He rides the subway while reading R-13 and attending to its rhythm.
scenes.inference: Repetition of a rhythm demonstrates that all artistic interpretations are identical.
scenes.question: Which fact belongs to the record?
choices: His rhythmic experience and the book he reads.
The universal goodness of rhythmic conformity.
reply: Correct: the narrative supports this narrower claim.
That larger claim has not been established.

scenes.title: 03 · A Guardian Behind His Shoulder
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: Someone is watching me; perhaps that is the greatest form of reassurance.
scenes.story: D-503 senses someone leaning over his shoulder and recognizes the silhouette and pink ears of S-4711. Instead of feeling threatened, he imagines the Guardian as a modern realization of the ancient guardian angel.
scenes.observation: A Guardian observes him while he reads, and D-503 finds comfort in the observation.
scenes.inference: Surveillance by itself establishes love, protection, or understanding.
scenes.question: What is observed and what is inferred?
choices: Attention from a Guardian, followed by D-503's interpretation.
reply: Correct: the narrative supports this narrower claim.
That larger claim has not been established.

scenes.title: 04 · Two Times Two
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: Four arrives every time. How could anyone quarrel with such certainty?
scenes.story: R-13's poem celebrates the reliable multiplication of two by two. D-503 exalts the multiplication table and leaps from the truth of a mathematical statement to the desirability of social life governed by fixed formulas.
scenes.observation: The arithmetic statement is true and the poem celebrates it.
scenes.inference: A correct equation proves every associated institution is morally right.
scenes.question: Where does the inference fail?
choices: Arithmetic correctness does not justify state authority.
An equation's result is a political mandate.
reply: Correct: the narrative supports this narrower claim.
That larger claim has not been established.

scenes.title: 05 · The Angel Does Not Answer
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: I am ready to open my whole mind. But he asks me nothing.
scenes.story: D-503 turns to S-4711 and looks into his eyes. The Guardian does not ask for a report or inquire into his thinking. D-503 nevertheless experiences the moment as reassuring and addresses his imagined readers instead.
scenes.observation: The Guardian remains silent while D-503 longs to confess his thoughts.
scenes.inference: Silence proves the watcher knows or approves every private thought.
scenes.question: Which uncertainty remains intact?
choices: The Guardian's actual beliefs and intentions.
reply: Correct: the narrative supports this narrower claim.
That larger claim has not been established.

scenes.title: 06 · The State Harnesses Poetry
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: Words have become useful, just like waves captured for power.
scenes.story: D-503 compares organized State poetry to generating energy from the ocean's waves. He lists officially commissioned works: mathematical lessons, hymns, praise of Guardians, and verse celebrating punishment. He sees State service as artistic progress.
scenes.observation: The State commissions literature for ideological, educational, and administrative purposes.
scenes.inference: Instrumental use establishes artistic freedom and universal merit.
scenes.question: What does this describe?
choices: A system of official artistic production.
The willing agreement of every poet and reader.
reply: Correct: the narrative supports this narrower claim.
That larger claim has not been established.

scenes.title: 07 · Exporting the Correct World
scenes.speaker: D-503 · ORIGINAL INTERPRETIVE DIALOGUE
scenes.line: We will teach the universe to make life as regular as ours.
scenes.story: He imagines the Integral bringing the One State's mathematics, poems, schedules, and governing ideals to readers on other planets. His account closes confidently, but confidence is not a substitute for evidence that the recipients would choose such a world.
scenes.observation: D-503 celebrates spreading the State's ideals beyond Earth.
scenes.inference: Technological reach establishes moral authority to govern others.
scenes.question: What carries into W013?
choices: A mission and ideology that must remain open to ethical scrutiny.
Proof that all future recipients consent.
reply: Correct: the narrative supports this narrower claim.
That larger claim has not been established.
